================================================================================
                           *** IMPORTANT WARNING ***
================================================================================

This command is designed ONLY for images created with:
  - Aaru alpha 16 or earlier

CRITICAL LIMITATIONS:

  1. There is NO WAY to automatically determine if this image actually needs
     an upgrade. The file format version cannot distinguish between images
     created with Aaru alpha 16 and newer versions.

  2. Attempting to upgrade images created with NEWER versions (Aaru alpha 17+)
     WILL CORRUPT THEM and make them UNREADABLE.

  3. There is NO GUARANTEE of success. The upgrade process may fail or
     produce an invalid image even with correct input.

  4. This command is provided as a LAST RESORT ONLY.

RECOMMENDED SOLUTION:

  The IDEAL and SAFEST solution is to re-dump the media using a current
  version of Aaru. This ensures data integrity and full compatibility with
  the latest format improvements.

Before proceeding:
  - Make sure you have a BACKUP of the original image file
  - Verify the image was created with Aaru alpha 16 or earlier
  - Consider re-dumping the media if possible
